objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-set-account-password-policy-to-unlimited-via-net
objects.description: The following analytic detects the use of net.exe to update user account policies to set passwords as non-expiring. It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on command-line executions involving "/maxpwage:unlimited" or "/maxpwage:49710", which achieve a similar outcome theoretically.
